sn44.4:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye …pe…
sn44.4:1.3: ko nu kho āvuso, hetu ko paccayo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.4:1.4: rūpaṃ kho āvuso, ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, rūpasamudayaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, rūpanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, rūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti:
sn44.4:1.6: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti,
sn44.4:1.7: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.4:1.8: vedanaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, vedanā samudayaṃ …pe…
sn44.4:1.11: viññāṇaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, viññāṇasamudayaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti,
sn44.4:1.13: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti,
sn44.4:1.14: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.4:2.1: rūpañca kho āvuso, jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, rūpasamudayaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, rūpanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, rūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti …pe…
sn44.4:2.2: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.4:2.3: vedanaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, vedanā samudayaṃ …pe…
sn44.4:2.6: viññāṇaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, viññāṇasamudayaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, viññāṇanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti,
sn44.4:2.7: na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti,
sn44.4:2.8: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti,
sn44.4:2.9: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.4:2.10: ayaṃ kho āvuso, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
